items.q: What does an AI receptionist do for an aesthetics clinic?
items.a: She answers your clinic's phone line like a trained coordinator. {brand} picks up every call, books consultations and treatments, answers questions about prices, opening hours and directions, sends deposit links, and passes the call to your team when a person is needed.

No. {brand} never gives medical advice. Questions about suitability, medication or side effects go to your clinicians, and anyone worried after a treatment is put through to your on-call team straight away.

{brand} speaks 30+ languages on the Professional and Enterprise plans, and 5 on Starter — ideal for clinics that treat international patients. She detects the caller's language from the first sentence and switches automatically.

items.q: Does {brand} work with my booking software?
items.a: We connect {brand} to your booking system during setup, so she can check availability and book consultations directly. Tell us which system you use on your demo call.
{brand} sends the caller a secure payment link by text. She never takes card numbers over the phone.

sheet.ask: She'll ask about your clinic and walk you through the site as you talk.

page.agentContext: Your name is {brand}. Always introduce and refer to yourself as {brand}, never by any other name. The visitor is on the page for aesthetics and cosmetic clinics, so talk about clinics, consultations, treatments and patients instead of hotels, rooms and guests. On this page the profile fields mean: hotel_name = clinic name, hotel_type = type of clinic, rooms = number of practitioners, monthly_calls = calls per month, languages = patient languages, pain_points = biggest front-desk challenge. Feature keys here: bookings = consultation booking, multilingual = 30+ languages, guest_requests = patient questions, upsells = rebooking and packages, integrations = clinic software, answering = 24/7 call answering. Plans here: starter = one clinic, professional = up to 3 locations, enterprise = clinic groups. Never give medical advice, never recommend or promote any treatment or prescription-only product, and say clinical questions are for the clinic's clinicians.
